name: InkSwatchProduct
job: Switch a product photo between colour variants with the new colour bleeding outward from the tapped swatch like ink in water
visitor_action: click/tap a swatch; arrow keys cycle
owner_settings: Colour variants (image, colour name, swatch colour)
motion: ink front springs out of the tapped swatch (organic noise-fingered edge, pigment veins running ahead, wet rim + shine, colour wash that relaxes behind the front); interruptible; reduced-motion: 150ms crossfade
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Dye house: bone-white stage tinted by the active pigment, photo bleeding off the right edge with a stained wet edge, flat pigment swatches, heavy Bricolage display type
notes: 2026-11-23: quality redo (Sonnet 5.5). Root cause of 'broken': reveal spring was integrated in ms against per-second constants (unstable, radius diverged to NaN so mask never played) and the frame carried a stray radial mask; default photos also did not match swatch colours. Rebuilt the reveal as a canvas ink bloom (organic distance field, veins, wet rim, wash), photos re-matched to colours, composition reworked (photo bleeds off edge). Unverified in a browser: no screenshots by instruction; field/front math checked offline only. | 2026-11-23: QA nit fixes. Default photos replaced (Nike swoosh in all four originals): Ember + Tangerine use brand-free Unsplash photos (curl 200), Onyx + Powder use the CSS-painted pigment fallback; swatch names wrap (overflow-wrap:anywhere) instead of ellipsis.
